tools.name: triage_check
tools.description: Decide how worried to be about a pain or symptom. Ask the runner short questions first, then pass what they told you as true/false answers (leave out anything they did not say). The red/amber/green level is decided by code from your answers; you cannot change it. Follow the level and next_step in the result. Never diagnose or suggest medication.

heat_illness_signs.description: confusion, collapse or hot skin after running in the heat

bone_pain_at_night.description: pinpointed on a bone and wakes them at night

changes_gait.description: limping or running differently because of it

bone_point_pain.description: pinpointed on a bone (shin, foot, hip)

tools.name: find_care
tools.description: Find nearby care from OpenStreetMap: physio, sports_med (sports doctor), gp, or urgent (hospital / emergency). Uses the place the runner typed, else the rough start of their latest run. If it returns need_place, ask which suburb or town they are in. Results are by distance only, not recommendations.

place.description: a suburb, town or address the runner typed
